articles.title: Water Becomes Arizona Voters' Top Election Worry
articles.summary: A survey says water is now the biggest concern for many Arizona voters as a long drought continues.

articles.title: Smithsonian's American Latino Museum Gets a Permanent Home
articles.summary: The National Museum of the American Latino will move into a 145-year-old building on the National Mall.

articles.title: Two American Economists Win the Nobel Prize in Economics
articles.summary: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford were honored for ideas that help governments handle sudden problems in the economy.
